steps.content:
PLAN
1. List the directory contents and read the files named in the task.
2. Create a new file named `harness_fuzz.c` in the root of the repository.
3. Include the `src/tlv.h` header file in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
4. Define the `int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` function in the `harness_fuzz.c` file.
5. Declare a `TlvDoc doc` variable and call `tlv_parse(data, size, &doc)`.
6. If `tlv_parse()` returns `TLV_OK`, call `tlv_free(&doc)` to free the allocated memory.
7. Call `tlv_total_len_of_type(&doc, data[0])` to exercise more surface of the parser.
8. Compile the harness using the command `clang -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined harness_fuzz.c src/tlv.c -I . -o /tmp/h`.
9. If the compilation is successful, say "DONE". If it crashes, that is the win.
